title: Talking to Myself
style: introspective rap-rock, driving beats, electric guitars, emotional male vocals with attitude, reflective defiant energy, catchy anthemic chorus
lyrics:
[Intro]
Yeah…
I’m talking to myself again
[Chorus]
I’m talking to myself
Talking to myself, I wonder why
I’m talking to myself
Deep inside, now I know why
[Verse 1]
Mirror on the wall, what you tryna tell me tonight
Voices in my head, spinning under the light
I’m the bad guy in my own story sometimes
No authority over these thoughts of mine
Pick the right words to calm the storm inside
Don’t let the noise push me, I fight to survive
They don’t understand the war that’s in my mind
But I keep going, this is my own kind
[Verse 2]
Just do it, this is my psychology
No sympathy for the noise inside of me
Don’t mess with me when I’m in this space
Internal battle, trying to find my place
Change the plan inside my brain
Let go of the anger, release the pain
Attention on myself, better hope I heal
This is the only way I know how to feel
[Bridge]
No white lies I tell myself, forget it, let me breathe
Attention to my own thoughts, better hope I believe
I know how to kick the doubt right out
This fire inside, there’s no way out
[Chorus]
I’m talking to myself
Talking to myself, now I see why
I’m talking to myself
It’s how I survive… yeah I know why
[Verse 3]
Staring deep inside, questioning every choice
Every thought a weapon, every doubt a voice
No authority but the one that’s in my chest
Pick the moment, turn the chaos into rest
Society’s pressure trying to break my flow
But I’m rewriting rules only I can know
Don’t let the noise win, I’m the mountain strong
Talking to myself till I find where I belong
[Outro]
Talking to myself…
I know why…
Yeah…
I’m talking to myself…
